fields.name: structure_file
fields.label: Structure (PDB or mmCIF)
fields.default: HEADER    PASTE A PROTEIN-LIGAND STRUCTURE HERE
fields.help: Only mmCIF files from RCSB are correctly parsed; PDB is the safer choice otherwise.

fields.name: num_samples
fields.label: Samples
fields.help: 50-100 is a good number for docking; fewer is fine for side-chain conformations alone.

fields.name: predict_ligand
fields.label: Ligands to predict (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated ligand IDs, as name3, name3-resno, or chain-name3-resno. Empty predicts every ligand present.

fields.name: fixed_ligand
fields.label: Ligands to hold fixed (optional)
fields.help: Comma-separated ligand IDs kept at their input coordinates instead of being predicted.

fields.name: target_res
fields.label: Crop-center residue (optional)
fields.help: A protein residue, as chain-resno. Required when the input has no ligand at all.

fields.name: exclude_common_ligands
fields.label: Exclude common crystallography additives
fields.help: Drops solvents and crystallography additives (AlphaFold 3's exclusion list) before predicting.

fields.name: predict_multi
fields.label: Predict every allowed ligand
fields.help: Scores every eligible ligand rather than only the ones named in predict_ligand.

fields.name: use_small_molecule
fields.label: Include the small molecule
fields.help: Off predicts side chains only (apo), ignoring any ligand in the input.
